messages:
maria: pushed a prototype to staging: /editor/policies/alpha — want quick UX + a11y feedback on the rules builder.
sam: looked at it — nice start. two quick things: priority ordering isn't obvious, and the drag handle only shows on hover which is bad for keyboard users.
jordan: agree. on small widths the move chevrons collide with the condition overflow — makes it hard to edit.
liam: we should support explicit keyboard reorder actions. suggestion: when a rule row is focused, `Ctrl+Up` / `Ctrl+Down` moves it. add tooltip for shortcut.
sam: also the disabled rule chip contrast fails WCAG. aria-bot: run an a11y scan?
aria-bot: Accessibility scan: 2 contrast issues found (rule-chip--disabled ratio 2.8:1), missing `aria-grabbed` on draggable items, and missing keyboard reorder hints.
maria: for validation copy — current error says 'Invalid condition'. Can we surface exact reason? e.g. "Condition references unknown parameter: `model_id`" and a link to the docs.
jordan: example rule that tripped validation:
```
{
  "priority": 10,
  "match": { "prefix": "summarize" },
  "route": "llama-70b-q4",
  "preview": true
}
```
this is a simplified payload from the simulator.
liam: preview simulation is fantastic. feature ask: let us replay a batch of example requests and show a routing trace per request — compact timeline that highlights which rule matched and fallbacks used.
sam: +1. the preview details should show 'why matched' with the evaluated values for each clause (e.g., tokens, length, header values).
maria: copy tweak suggestion: change 'Fallback to compatible variant' -> 'Fallback to lower-capacity variant' to reduce ambiguity for non-ML readers.
jordan: tiny behavior nit: when you insert a new rule we default it to bottom. PMs prefer new rules at the top. make insertion configurable? default to top with a microcopy: "Higher priority rules evaluated first." 
liam: mobile UX: condition lines wrap badly. propose an expand/collapse for conditions with a 'Show conditions' affordance.
sam: propose a 'Validation summary' banner in the editor header showing counts (errors / warnings / info). clicking it expands a panel with line-level messages and quick-fix buttons.
maria: action items: @sam write keyboard + a11y spec, @jordan adjust drag affordance and insertion behavior, @liam add preview trace hook and batch replay, @maria update copy and validation messaging.
jordan: extra small feature: auto-generate rule names from conditions instead of "New rule 1" — e.g., "Prefix: summarize" or "High tokens -> fallback".
sam: :thumbsup: and add unit tests for the validation messages in the eval harness so we don't regress wording.
aria-bot: Reminder: accessibility re-review scheduled Tue 10:00am PT.
maria: thanks everyone — i'll drop updated Figma frames and a short video of the preview replay later today. ping me if you'd like to pair on the a11y spec."
